entities.summary: Traugott Martin von Sauberzweig was a Prussian Generalleutnant who served on both the Eastern and Western Front in the German Army during World War I. In 1915 he had been Military Governor of Brussels in the days of Edith Cavell's execution, and in connection with this tragedy his name was prominently mentioned. The Cavell case was the reason that von Sauberzweig was supplanted. He served as chief of staff on the 8th Army in Ukraine in 1916 and was awarded the Pour le Mérite on 6 September 1917.
